metadata.question: Does the agricultural land around Peoria, Illinois show more brown fields in October 2022 compared to September 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (10 m) for crop fields near Peoria, IL. ROI: ~40 km radius buffer centred on Peoria to capture surrounding farmland. Dates: 2022-09-01 → 2022-09-30 (Sept) and 2022-10-01 → 2022-10-31 (Oct). 2. Masking: Apply S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY ≥ 60 mask, keep scl==4–5 as vegetated land. 3. Brown-field proxy: Low NDVI (< 0.3) after masking out water/urban. 4. Logic: Compute % of agricultural pixels with NDVI < 0.3 in each month. If Oct % minus Sep % > 0 (even tiny) → “Yes” (A), else “No” (B). Guard against C1 (no images), C2 (no valid crop pixels), C3 (None/NaN). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. ROI & dates pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.589, 40.717]) # Peoria, IL roi = pt.buffer(40000) # ~40 km ag area sept = ('2022-09-01', '2022-09-30') octo = ('2022-10-01', '2022-10-31') # 2. Helper: load S2, cloud/land mask, NDVI, keep crop pixels def load_and_mask(start, end): ic = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(*start) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 70))) if ic.size().getInfo() == 0: return None # mask clouds & bare soil/snow, keep veg land (scl 4,5) def prep(img): qa = img.select('SCL') veg = qa.eq(4).Or(qa.eq(5)) ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI') return ndvi.updateMask(veg).clip(roi) return ic.map(prep) # 3. Sept collection ic_sep = load_and_mask(sept, sept) if ic_sep is None: print("Sept images: 0") print("C1") else: ndSep = ic_sep.mean() sepCount = ndSep.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() if sepCount == 0: print("Sept valid pixels: 0") print("C2") else: sepBrown = ndSep.lt(0.3).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() sepPct = sepBrown * 100 # percent brown fields # 4. Oct collection ic_oct = load_and_mask(octo, octo) if ic_oct is None: print("Oct images: 0") print("C1") else: ndOct = ic_oct.mean() octCount = ndOct.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() if octCount == 0: print("Oct valid pixels: 0") print("C2") else: octBrown = ndOct.lt(0.3).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() octPct = octBrown * 100 diff = octPct - sepPct print(f"Sept brown%: {sepPct:.1f} | Oct brown%: {octPct:.1f} | Δ: {diff:+.1f}") if diff > 0: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. ROI & dates
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.589, 40.717])      # Peoria, IL
roi = pt.buffer(40000)                         # ~40 km ag area
sept = ('2022-09-01', '2022-09-30')
octo = ('2022-10-01', '2022-10-31')

# 2. Helper: load S2, cloud/land mask, NDVI, keep crop pixels
def load_and_mask(start, end):
    ic = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
          .filterBounds(roi)
          .filterDate(*start)
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 70)))
    if ic.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    # mask clouds & bare soil/snow, keep veg land (scl 4,5)
    def prep(img):
        qa = img.select('SCL')
        veg = qa.eq(4).Or(qa.eq(5))
        ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
        return ndvi.updateMask(veg).clip(roi)
    return ic.map(prep)

# 3. Sept collection
ic_sep = load_and_mask(sept, sept)
if ic_sep is None:
    print("Sept images: 0")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    ndSep = ic_sep.mean()
    sepCount = ndSep.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                  geometry=roi, scale=1000,
                                  maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    if sepCount == 0:
        print("Sept valid pixels: 0")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        sepBrown = ndSep.lt(0.3).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi,
            scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        sepPct = sepBrown * 100      # percent brown fields

        # 4. Oct collection
        ic_oct = load_and_mask(octo, octo)
        if ic_oct is None:
            print("Oct images: 0")
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        else:
            ndOct = ic_oct.mean()
            octCount = ndOct.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi,
                scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
            if octCount == 0:
                print("Oct valid pixels: 0")
                print("<answer>C2</answer>")
            else:
                octBrown = ndOct.lt(0.3).reduceRegion(
                    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi,
                    scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
                octPct = octBrown * 100
                diff = octPct - sepPct
                print(f"Sept brown%: {sepPct:.1f} | Oct brown%: {octPct:.1f} | Δ: {diff:+.1f}")
                if diff > 0:
                    print("<answer>A</answer>")
                else:
                    print("<answer>B</answer>")
